abstract: I analyse how global value chain (GVC) position and exposure to foreign environmental regulation shape firms’ CO 2 emissions in a large emerging economy. Combining detailed energy-use records for Indian manufacturing firms with firm-specific GVC position indicators and exposure to foreign environmental policy stringency (EPS), I show three main results. A one-unit increase in upstreamness–moving further from final consumption roughly being equivalent to the average GVC position of textile firms to that of basic metals firms–raises direct CO 2 emissions by 28 % and CO 2 per unit of value added by 35 %. Second, the higher CO 2 intensity of upstream firms becomes statistically insignificant for firms that operate in industries that are highly exposed to stringent environmental regulations: the interaction term between upstreamness and EPS is negative significant and fully offsets the baseline effect. Third, exporting per se does not moderate the upstreamness-CO 2 relationship, indicating that over-proportional technology upgrading in upstream positions is driven by exposure to destination-specific factors. Overall, the evidence suggests that foreign stakeholder pressure is transmitted through GVCs and can help decarbonise energy-intensive upstream producers. • Firm-level evidence links GVC upstreamness to higher direct CO 2 intensity. • Within industries, upstream firms emit 28 % more CO 2 and 35 % more per value added. • Exposure to stringent foreign environmental regulation diminishes the higher upstreamness CO 2 intensity. • Exporting itself does not alter the upstreamness-CO 2 intensity relationship. • Cutting emissions in upstream sectors is essential for global CO 2 targets.
abstract_zh: 我分析了全球价值链（GVC）位置及对外国环境法规的暴露程度如何影响大型新兴经济体中企业的二氧化碳排放。通过将印度制造业企业的详细能源使用记录与企业特定的GVC位置指标及对外国环境政策严格性（EPS）的暴露程度相结合，我展示了三个主要结果。上游度每增加一个单位——即进一步远离最终消费，大致相当于从纺织企业的平均GVC位置转向基础金属企业的位置——直接二氧化碳排放量增加28%，单位增加值二氧化碳排放量增加35%。其次，对于处于高度暴露于严格环境法规行业的企业而言，上游企业较高的二氧化碳强度在统计上变得不显著：上游度与EPS之间的交互项为负且显著，完全抵消了基准效应。第三，出口本身并不调节上游度与二氧化碳之间的关系，这表明上游位置中不成比例的技术升级是由目的地特定因素的暴露所驱动的。总体而言，证据表明外国利益相关者的压力通过GVC传导，有助于高能耗上游生产者的脱碳。• 企业层面的证据将GVC上游度与更高的直接二氧化碳强度联系起来。• 在行业内，上游企业每单位增加值排放的二氧化碳多28%，每单位增加值排放多35%。• 暴露于严格的外国环境法规会削弱上游度带来的更高二氧化碳强度。• 出口本身并不改变上游度与二氧化碳强度之间的关系。• 削减上游部门的排放对于实现全球二氧化碳目标至关重要。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
title: Upstreamness, foreign environmental regulation and CO2 emissions in Indian manufacturing firms
title_zh: 上游度、外国环境规制与印度制造业企业的二氧化碳排放

abstract: This paper revisits the debate between Harsanyi and Rawls on collective decision-making with impartiality (Veil of Ignorance), focusing on how different levels of uncertainty influence the resulting social welfare functions. By incorporating ambiguity into the Impartial Observer framework, the paper constructs a continuum of compromise positions between Harsanyi’s utilitarian approach and Rawls’s maximin rule. In the proposed model, the independence between the uncertainty faced by the Impartial Observer over the distributions of identities and the uncertainty faced by each individual over the distributions of outcomes allows us to introduce ambiguity on both identity acts and/or outcome acts to explore various configurations where the Impartial Observer’s preference representation changes based on the type and level of uncertainty considered. The results offer a more nuanced understanding of impartiality in social choice contexts and help clarify the philosophical foundations of the Harsanyi–Rawls debate.
abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了哈萨尼与罗尔斯关于公正集体决策（无知之幕）的辩论，聚焦于不同程度的不确定性如何影响由此产生的社会福利函数。通过将模糊性纳入公正观察者框架，本文构建了介于哈萨尼功利主义方法与罗尔斯最大最小规则之间的连续折中立场。在所提出的模型中，公正观察者面临的身份分布不确定性与每个个体面临的结果分布不确定性之间的独立性，使我们得以在身份行为及/或结果行为上引入模糊性，以探索各种配置，其中公正观察者的偏好表示随所考虑的不确定性的类型和水平而变化。研究结果增进了对社会选择情境中公正性的细致理解，并有助于澄清哈萨尼-罗尔斯辩论的哲学基础。
title: Impartial observer theorem with ambiguity
title_zh: 含模糊性的公正观察者定理
